question: What is the difference between a logo and actual branding?
transcript_excerpt: A logo is not branding at all—it's just a logo. Branding is the environment and culture that you promote, what your brand stands for, and the meaning behind your brand. A logo, graphics, flyers, and business cards would actually fall more into promotion because they are what you use to promote your brand. Branding is what people think about your brand or your company—it's the reputation your business has and what people know you for.

question: What does branding actually mean according to design experts?
transcript_excerpt: A brand is the result of what customers think about your product, service, or company. It ends up in their heads and hearts—they take whatever raw materials you throw at them and create something out of it. Every customer has a different brand of you, so when you create a brand, you're creating millions of brands. A brand is a reputation, and it's affected by everything: your products, messaging, design, culture, and how employees behave.

question: How does personal opinion on social media affect brand reputation?
transcript_excerpt: Once you become a brand or own a brand, certain things you have to stay away from because you don't want to tarnish your brand. Business owners don't chime in on taboo topics because people might confuse the intent of your brand with your personal opinion. Everything you do affects your brand—whether it's your personal time, what you do in a club, or what you say in church. It's always going to reflect on your brand, always.

question: What percentage of business revenue should be reinvested back into the company?
transcript_excerpt: If you make a thousand dollars in a week, at least 60 percent of it needs to go back into the business, mandatory. You made a thousand and you're putting that money back into your business to make another thousand or two thousand, or to double or triple your money. You can't make a thousand, put in a hundred and expect to make another thousand—it doesn't work that way because you have to market and promote your business, and effective marketing and promotion costs.
